visual.description: A rounded full-width banner sits above the header with centered promo text, a Claim Now button, and a dismiss icon at the far right.
Dark header with logo and four nav items on the left, phone number, Support, Log In, and a Get a Demo button aligned right.
Full-bleed night-sky background with centered stacked content: star rating, large serif headline, subcopy, and two side-by-side CTAs.

A large three-panel app mockup (message list, conversation, customer info sidebar) is centered below the hero text and overlaps the desert imagery, with a floating incoming-call card at the bottom left.
Light band with a trust statement on the left and seven grayscale brand logos spaced evenly across the remaining width.
Eyebrow tag and large serif heading occupy the left half while three vertically-divided stat columns (interactions, businesses, years) sit on the right.
A full-width segmented tab bar with four equal tabs, the active tab filled dark, sitting above the tab panel.
Inside a bordered container, a left column stacks seven capability list cards while the right two-thirds shows a large layered device/app visual over desert photography.
Two rounded image cards sit side by side below the panel, the left card roughly twice the width of the right, each with caption text beneath.
A bordered card splits evenly: left half holds eyebrow tag, oversized serif headline, subheading, body copy, and a CTA; right half is a full-bleed twilight sky image.
Three equal-width cards, each with a full-width image on top and icon, heading, body copy, and small tag chips below.
A centered modal overlays the page, split with offer text and CTA on the left and a phone mockup with three always-on feature chips on the right.
A full-bleed rounded banner with an illustrated blue night landscape, text and CTA anchored to the left half.
Three equal cards below the banner, each with icon, heading, body copy, and small labeled chips at the bottom.
Eyebrow tag and large serif heading on the left, three review-platform rating blocks separated by vertical dividers on the right, with a horizontal rule beneath.
Two rows of three equal-width testimonial cards, each with brand logo top-left, metric pill top-right, quote, and star rating with attribution below a divider.

Heading on the left with prev/next arrow buttons on the right, above a horizontally scrolling row of five equal stat cards (one outlined as active) with industry tag, large percentage, company name, description, and case-study link.
Two rounded image cards side by side, the left roughly twice as wide as the right, each with a Learn More link in overlay text.

Left-aligned section header and subcopy above two toggle groups (Small business/Enterprise, Monthly/Annually), then three equal pricing cards with the third styled dark, followed by a centered fine-print row.
Full-width serif heading above a split: a wide video/image card with founder attribution on the left and a narrower dark LinkedIn quote card on the right.
A persistent pill-shaped bar floats bottom-center with offer text, Learn More and Buy Now buttons, and a dismiss icon, alongside a fixed circular Chat button at the bottom right.
